newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Friday January 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Friday January 3.

text.p: Following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.

Prosecution witness in Italy's sensational "monster of Florence" serial murder case said to have admitted killing some of the 16 vitims between 1968 and 1985 but defence lawyer denies labourer Giancarlo Lotti made admission (all).
Snow returns creating fresh problems in northern Italy, alarm over risk of avalanches in alps, weather seen worsening (all).

Treasury says Italy's 1996 PSBR was a provisional 138.5 trillion lire against 130.2 trillion in 1995. Official government target for 1996 was 123.0 trillion lire - extra mini-budget looks likely (all).
Stock and bond markets tumble following Wall Street - growth in U.S. economy rekindles fears of interest rate hikes (all).
Labour minister Tiziano Treu has informal contacts with with metalworkers' unions and employers in long-runnning pay dispute ahead of formal talks due to resume next week (all).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
